title: digest_test
description: Digest projection of a test source file (tests/**/*.py) or test fixture (tests/**/*.json). Captures structural facts — discovered test functions, pytest markers, top-level imports, fixture references, and any hardcoded path literals — for drift, coverage, and I10 (hardcoded path) checks.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a test digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root (e.g. tests/unit/test_cli.py).

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

test_file_path.description: Echo of source_file; included in payload so downstream consumers don't have to re-derive it.

test_count.description: Count of `def test_*` functions for Python sources. Null for JSON fixture files.

test_names.description: Names of `def test_*` functions in declaration order. Empty array for fixture .json files.

markers.description: Pytest marker decorators (e.g. @pytest.mark.skipif, @pytest.mark.parametrize). Captures the marker name as a bare string (without arguments).

imports.description: Top-level `import` / `from ... import` module references. Empty for fixture .json files.

fixtures_referenced.description: Distinct `fixture_path` string values referenced inside JSON fixture documents (string-matched, not schema-aware). Empty for Python sources.

hardcoded_paths.description: Path-like string literals detected via regex (absolute paths or relative paths with at least one slash and a file-extension suffix). Surface candidates for I10 (hardcoded path) review; downstream reviewers decide whether each is legitimate.

is_fixture.description: True when the source is a .json fixture rather than a .py test module.
